items.title: Lamar Jackson: Facing 6-to-10 week absence
items.text:
Jackson (thumb) is "doing well" and is expected to be out for "6-to-10 weeks," per head coach Jesse Minter.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: In line to work through elbow issue Sunday
items.text:
Mahomes (elbow/knee) has had "limited swelling" and "limited pain" in his right (throwing) elbow in recent days, and is in line to start Sunday's game against the Falcons, Ian Rapoport of ESPN and NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kirk Cousins: Expected to start versus Green Bay
items.text:
Cousins is expected to start Sunday's game against the Packers, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Not in uniform for Friday's practice
items.text:
Stevenson (knee) was present but not in uniform for Friday's practice, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Working toward return, but timetable TBD
items.text:
Coach Mike Vrabel said Friday that Henderson (illness) is working hard to get back, while acknowledging that he doesn't have a timetable for when that may occur, Mark Daniels of MassLive.com reports.
